summary: Frontend-only verification of the two Tina fixes. Code inspection confirmed Bug 1 fix in TinaChatScreen.tsx (auto-onComplete on completion_percentage>=100 removed in both handleMoviesReceived (lines 554-560 comment) and sendToTina (lines 659-664 comment); the only auto-close paths are archetype_reveal at line 626-630 and exit_intent at line 610-614). Code inspection confirmed Bug 2 fix in onboarding.tsx (mergeTinaData now RETURNS the freshly collected list at line 206; shouldSkipSelectionStep and findNextStep accept a collectedOverride; handleTinaComplete/handleTinaExit pass the fresh list to avoid the stale-closure). HOWEVER while validating Bug 2 I found a NEW related bug: mergeTinaData's ARRAY_FIELDS set incorrectly included 'partnerPreference', which is a STRING in ProfileData (single_select on backend, returns e.g. 'Women'). Because of this, when Tina collected partnerPreference and user skipped, mergeTinaData silently dropped the value -> the 'Who do you want to meet?' page would STILL render — exactly the user-reported bug. I confirmed this by hitting POST /api/tina/chat directly: after sending relationshipIntent + partnerPreference + languagesSpoken then 'skip', the backend returned profile_data: { relationshipIntent: ['Serious relationship'], partnerPreference: 'Women' (string), languagesSpoken: [...] } and 30% completion. With 'partnerPreference' in ARRAY_FIELDS, the string was being filtered out. FIXED by removing 'partnerPreference' from the ARRAY_FIELDS set in /app/frontend/app/onboarding.tsx (kept the array-only fields: topMovies, genres, filmLanguages, languagesSpoken, relationshipIntent, uploadedPictures, pictures). End-to-end UI walk-through was blocked because the BasicInfoStep DOB validation requires the React Native ScrollView onScroll callback to fire (sets ageConfirmed=true). On the Expo web build that ScrollView renders as a CSS overflow scroller but Playwright wheel/scroll dispatch does not trigger the React-Native-web onScroll handler — the Continue button stayed aria-disabled='true' across multiple wheel/scroll attempts. This is a tooling limitation, not a product bug. Backend /api/tina/chat returned 200 on every call throughout testing; no 500s or tracebacks in backend.err.log.

ui_bugs.issue: 'partnerPreference' was wrongly in ARRAY_FIELDS — backend returns it as a string (e.g. 'Women'), so it was being silently dropped. Result: Bug 2 fix did NOT work for partnerPreference — the 'Who do you want to meet?' page still appeared after Tina-skip. FIXED in this iteration (removed partnerPreference from the set). Reference: /app/frontend/app/onboarding.tsx:179-183

Optional: add testIDs to the DOB Day/Month/Year scrollers in BasicInfoStep (or expose a hidden onChange trigger) so end-to-end web Playwright tests can drive DOB without relying on RN-web's onScroll event. Right now the DOB column is un-driveable from Playwright wheel events, which made Tina untestable end-to-end on web.

Optional: align frontend ARRAY_FIELDS with the actual ProfileData type — consider deriving the set programmatically from initialProfileData (Array.isArray(initialProfileData[k])) to avoid future drift.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/onboarding.tsx:179 — Hand-maintained ARRAY_FIELDS set is fragile. partnerPreference was already mis-classified despite being a string in /app/frontend/src/types.ts:18. Suggest replacing with a runtime derivation: `Object.keys(initialProfileData).filter(k => Array.isArray((initialProfileData as any)[k]))`. That eliminates an entire class of bug.

/app/frontend/src/components/TinaChatScreen.tsx:554-560 and 659-664 — Comments correctly explain why auto-close on completion% is removed; archetype_reveal (line 626) and exit_intent (line 610) are the only legitimate close paths. Confirmed clean.

/app/frontend/src/components/BasicInfoStep.tsx:215 — `isValid` depends on `ageConfirmed`, which is only flipped by validateAndSetDate when the scroll handler fires. Since default selectedDay/Month/Year are pre-populated (15/6/currentYear-25), consider calling validateAndSetDate once on mount unconditionally so the Continue button is enabled by default when the defaults already represent an adult. This would also remove the Playwright web-testing blocker.

To test from Playwright on web, you currently cannot drive the BasicInfo DOB picker (RN-web ScrollView onScroll does not fire from page.mouse.wheel) — easiest workaround is either (a) test on Expo Go on a real device, (b) temporarily call validateAndSetDate on mount in BasicInfoStep, or (c) inject dobDay/dobMonth/dobYear into AsyncStorage via a draft-profile store before navigating to /onboarding. Backend Tina /api/tina/chat verified working (200 on all calls). User_id formats accepted: any string. Skip phrase that triggers exit_intent: 'skip', 'bye', etc.
rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE of the residual Bug-2: In /app/frontend/app/onboarding.tsx the developer authored a defensive ARRAY_FIELDS set inside mergeTinaData to drop any value Tina returns whose runtime type doesn't match the array-typed render path. But the set included 'partnerPreference', which in ProfileData (/app/frontend/src/types.ts:18) is declared `partnerPreference: string` and on the backend (tina_service.py:46-51) is a single_select returning a string like 'Women'. So when Tina collected gender preference and the user skipped, the merge step did `if (!Array.isArray(value)) { console.warn('Ignoring non-array partnerPreference from Tina:', value); return; }` and the field was dropped both from `data.partnerPreference` and from the `collected[]` list. handleTinaExit then called findNextStep with a collected list that did NOT include 'partnerPreference', so the next-step computation re-rendered STEP_PARTNER_PREF=4 ('Who do you want to meet?'). FIX: removed 'partnerPreference' from the ARRAY_FIELDS set (kept only fields that are actually arrays in ProfileData). MITIGATION going forward: derive ARRAY_FIELDS from `initialProfileData` at module init so the set can never drift from the type.
